correctness.rationale: For an arbitrary world w let A,B be its E1,E2 cells. If incomparable, valuation p=A and q=A∩B makes S(p→q) and Sp true but Sq false, violating K. If comparable, S(X) iff (A∩B)⊆X for all X, so the operator agrees at every formula evaluation with the ordinary S5 box over E1∩E2, including nestings. The bipartite graph of intersecting partition blocks has only star components, because a block meeting two disjoint blocks must contain each; a join-component is therefore a whole block of at least one partition. A connected component with k labels has exactly c_k=2B_k−1 ordered decorations (indiscrete partition on either side, subtract double count). Exponential assembly yields exp(2exp(e^z−1)−e^z−1) and distinguished-component recurrence. Independent enumeration of every ordered partition pair n=1..6 yielded L=1,4,19,111,774,6229; exhaustive valuation tests for n<=3 verified iff K distribution. Finite checks are corroboration, not proof of all-n claims.

value.rationale: The exceptional transition from non-normal someone-knows to a normal S5 operator is an intrinsic semantic problem. A fixed-frame iff criterion, componentwise mixed refinement description and complete ordered labelled count in every finite size are natural structural and enumerative invariants, not an arbitrary small-instance slice. The result is bounded to two agents and does not claim the already known n=3 non-normal counterexample as new.

final_claim: For any nonempty finite labelled two-S5 frame (W,E1,E2), distribution of S=K1∨K2 under all valuations holds iff each pair of information cells at the same world is nested, iff each join-component E1∨E2 is an indiscrete block of one agent. Then S=K_(E1∩E2) for all formulas. The count L_n of ordered pairs of normal frames has EGF exp(2exp(e^z−1)−e^z−1) with L0=1 and L1..L6=1,4,19,111,774,6229; first failure at n=3 (six ordered bad pairs).
limitations: Two finite S5 agents only; no ≥3-agent or unlabelled/isomorphism census.
The 2021 three-world K failure and exponential formula are existing background, not novel.
